<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD file defines a package for `gridcraft-bin`, a prebuilt binary release of an open-source spreadsheet application. The source URLs point directly to GitHub releases of the official upstream repository, which is consistent with expected packaging practices. The checksums for both x86_64 and aarch64 architectures are provided and match the respective binaries, ensuring integrity. The build process consists solely of installing prebuilt binaries and associated files (icons, licenses, documentation) into standard system directories under `$pkgdir`, which is appropriate for a `-bin` package.

There are no signs of malicious activity such as network requests during packaging, obfuscated commands, or unauthorized file modifications. The package depends only on common system libraries, and optional GPU support is declared without enforcing it. The use of `cp -a` and `install` commands is standard for copying prebuilt assets and poses no risk in this context. All operations are confined to the package build directory and the destination root.

The license files are correctly installed under `/usr/share/licenses`, and the package provides and conflicts with the base name as expected. No post-install scripts or hooks are present, eliminating a common vector for stealthy system modifications. Overall, the PKGBUILD adheres to safe, conventional practices for distributing a precompiled application via the AUR.
</details>
